instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Pat 24 of the mini sausages dry with paper towels.
Unroll the crescent dough and separate it into 8 triangles. Cut each triangle into 3 thin triangles with a sharp knife or pizza cutter.
Set a sausage on the wide end of each small triangle and roll it up toward the point. Place them seam side down on the sheets, about 1 inch apart.
Beat the egg with 1 tbsp water in a small bowl. Brush it lightly over the dough, keeping it from pooling around the sausages.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden brown.
Let them cool for 5 minutes before serving. The sausages stay hot inside.
method_notes: The sources agree on cutting crescent dough into thin triangles, rolling a mini sausage in each and baking at 375°F until golden. Small Town Woman adds a sliver of cheese and an egg wash with bagel seasoning; the other keeps it to two ingredients. I kept the egg wash and left out the cheese and seasoning. The lead is rated 5 from 64 votes.
